_meta.description: Single source of truth for which symbols are eligible for live/paper trading. A symbol is TRADEABLE only if it has BOTH sufficient price history AND verified multi-day cost calibration data. Statuses: tradeable (both passes of the Phase 1 bar cleared), verifying (first pass cleared, re-verification pending), measuring (in measurement, pre-pass), candidate (discovered, not yet measuring), excluded (not eligible).

OIL restored to its real single-snapshot measurement.
